name: SZTAKI - Institute for Computer Science and Control
description: The first registered domain in Hungarian internet history, cradle of the national .hu ccTLD registry and early networking research.
historicalSignificance: Delegated just before the official IANA .hu delegation on Nov 7, 1991. Sztaki engineers established Hungary's first IP routing and DNS root servers.
currentStatusNote: Active official research institute portal running continuously since 1991.
techSnapshot90s: Sun SPARCserver, NCSA HTTPd / CERN httpd

name: IIF / NIIF - Information Infrastructure Development
description: National academic network initiative connecting Hungarian universities, research centers, and libraries.
historicalSignificance: Built the academic backbone network (HBONE) that carried virtually all Hungarian academic data in the 1990s.
currentStatusNote: Active (now integrated into KIFÜ / governmental higher-ed infrastructure).
notableMilestone: Funded early Hungarian dial-up modems and university leased lines

name: Budapest University of Technology and Economics
description: Hungary's top engineering university; student and faculty servers hosted numerous pioneering Hungarian web projects in the 1990s.
historicalSignificance: Hosted the legendary Schönherz Dormitory (KSZK) network and early mirror servers for Linux distributions, Usenet newsgroups, and IRC.
currentStatusNote: Fully online and modernized, primary university portal.
notableMilestone: Home of the first university web servers and student BBS in Hungary

name: Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE)
description: Leading Hungarian science and humanities university with deep roots in early mathematics and informatics networking.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered early email systems (X.400, sendmail) and university-wide gopher servers before the WWW explosion.
currentStatusNote: Fully online, central university portal.

name: KFKI - Central Research Institute for Physics
description: Central physics and nuclear research campus on Csillebérc, heavily involved in early high-energy physics data links with CERN.
historicalSignificance: KFKI physicists were among the first in Hungary to communicate via CERN WWW protocols due to collaborations on LEP/LHC.
currentStatusNote: Still online at kfki.hu, hosting research archives and department sites.
notableMilestone: Direct link to Tim Berners-Lee's early web experiments at CERN

name: Janus Pannonius Tudományegyetem (JPTE - Pécs)
description: The historic university of Pécs before the 2000 university integration; primary regional HBONE academic internet backbone node of South Transdanubia.
historicalSignificance: One of the foundational academic nodes in Hungarian internet history, hosting the South Transdanubian regional Gopher servers, early linguistic databases, and the Pollack Mihály engineering faculty networks.
currentStatusNote: Active historical domain redirecting to pte.hu (University of Pécs).
notableMilestone: HBONE academic node for South Transdanubia and regional Gopher services
techSnapshot90s: Sun SPARCserver, CERN httpd, NCSA HTTPd

name: Kossuth Lajos Tudományegyetem (Now University of Debrecen)
description: Debrecen University historic domain name representing East Hungary's primary networking node.
historicalSignificance: Crucial eastern hub on the HBONE network, maintaining early regional ftp archives.
currentStatusNote: Active domain redirecting to unideb.hu.

name: József Attila Tudományegyetem (Now University of Szeged)
description: Szeged University historic domain, home to southern Hungary's most active early informatics faculty.
historicalSignificance: Famous for early Linux kernel contributions, TeX typography archives, and student programming competitions.
currentStatusNote: Active redirecting to u-szeged.hu.

name: Hungarian Academy of Sciences (MTA)
description: Central body for Hungarian scientific scholarship and research network coordination.
historicalSignificance: Oversaw early national IT modernization strategies in post-communist Hungary.
currentStatusNote: Active primary portal for the Academy.

name: Pécsi Tudományegyetem (University of Pécs)
description: Hungary's first university (founded in 1367 by King Louis the Great). Central higher-education gateway for South Transdanubia.
historicalSignificance: One of the earliest regional university web presences in Central Europe, hosting extensive digitized faculty bibliographies, scientific journals, and student research portals.
currentStatusNote: Active primary portal for the University of Pécs.
notableMilestone: Digital home of Hungary's oldest university founded in 1367

name: Pécsi Orvostudományi Egyetem (POTE Medical School)
description: The historic Medical University of Pécs, internationally renowned for clinical research, international medical training, and medical informatics.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered early medical informatics and clinical network links in South Hungary, connecting regional hospitals and academic clinics in the mid-1990s.
currentStatusNote: Active historical domain redirecting to PTE Általános Orvostudományi Kar (aok.pte.hu).

name: DataNet - Early Commercial ISP Pioneer
description: One of Hungary's very first commercial Internet Service Providers offering dial-up access to businesses and homes.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered leased lines and modem dial-in pools for non-academic users in the early 90s.
currentStatusNote: Acquired by GTS / Invitel; domain remains registered and maintained.

name: Matáv (Magyar Távközlési Vállalat)
description: The national telecommunications monopoly that constructed the digital ISDN and ADSL infrastructure across Hungary.
historicalSignificance: Launched Matávnet in 1997, built the Origo.hu portal in 1998, and operated the first widespread ISDN dial-up packages.
currentStatusNote: Active redirect to telekom.hu (official Magyar Telekom portal).

name: National Széchényi Library (OSZK)
description: Hungary's national library located in Buda Castle; cradle of the Hungarian Electronic Library (MEK).
historicalSignificance: Digitized historic Hungarian literature, incunabula, and created the first national online library catalogs in Central Europe.
currentStatusNote: Active national library web portal.

name: C3 - Center for Culture & Communication
description: Legendary cultural & net-art lab founded with the Soros Foundation. Launched Freemail in 1997!
historicalSignificance: Epicenter of Hungarian net-culture, internet art, free community servers, and creator of the legendary freemail.hu service.
currentStatusNote: Still online running cultural archives, media art exhibitions, and early web retrospectives.
notableMilestone: Invented Freemail in 1997, hosted Hungary's first internet art showcases

name: Magyar Elektronikus Könyvtár (MEK)
description: The Hungarian Electronic Library - one of the world's earliest digital public libraries, established by Moldován István and Drótos László.
historicalSignificance: Began as a Gopher and email-based digital book distribution service in 1994 before launching its iconic web interface. Still preserves hundreds of thousands of classic works.
originalFounderOrOrg: Drótos László, Moldován István (MEK Egyesület / OSZK)
currentStatusNote: Still online in its beloved retro-friendly classic format with millions of monthly readers!
notableMilestone: One of the longest continually operating digital libraries on Earth

name: Elender Computer & ISP
description: Pioneering Hungarian ISP founded by Kóka János, famous for affordable dial-up and dial-in modem banks.
historicalSignificance: Competed fiercely with Matáv and Datanet to bring unmetered nighttime dialup access to Hungarian households.
currentStatusNote: Domain maintained under telecom group portfolio.

name: Internetto - The First Hungarian Online Magazine
description: The pioneering digital magazine of the Hungarian internet, founded by Nyírő András, Gerényi Gábor, and Uj Péter at IDG.
historicalSignificance: Invented Hungarian online journalism, live internet broadcasting, interactive comment forums, and was the direct precursor to Index.hu in 1999.
currentStatusNote: Active historical archive and redirect.
notableMilestone: Broadcasted live cyber-café roundtables and the 1996 Internet Expo

name: Hungary.org - Early Diaspora & Tourism Portal
description: Early English-language portal about Hungarian culture, history, and travel created by diaspora academics in the US and Sztaki.
historicalSignificance: Showcased Hungary to the early global World Wide Web audience during the transition era.
currentStatusNote: Active informational resource.

name: Magyar Köztársaság Országgyűlése (Hungarian Parliament)
description: Official legislative portal providing transcripts, voting records, and bill texts directly to citizens.
historicalSignificance: One of the earliest parliaments in Central & Eastern Europe to publish legislative proceedings and member databases on the web.
currentStatusNote: Active parliament portal (also accessible via parlament.hu).

name: Fővárosi Szabó Ervin Könyvtár (FSZEK)
description: Budapest's metropolitan public library network, pioneering public internet terminals in reading rooms.
historicalSignificance: First public library network in Budapest to install dial-up internet terminals where ordinary citizens could browse the web for free.
currentStatusNote: Active modern municipal library portal.

name: Pécs Megyei Jogú Város (City of Pécs Official Portal)
description: The official municipal portal for the 2,000-year-old Roman city of Sopianae (Pécs), early European Capital of Culture candidate and Mediterranean jewel of South Transdanubia.
historicalSignificance: One of the first major provincial Hungarian cities to build a comprehensive multilingual municipal portal featuring tourist guides, city council archives, and Early Christian Necropolis (Ókeresztény sírkamrák) exhibits.
currentStatusNote: Fully active modern municipal and citizen portal for Pécs.
notableMilestone: First comprehensive provincial municipal city web guide in Hungary

name: Zsolnay Porcelánmanufaktúra (Zsolnay Porcelain Factory)
description: World-renowned Pécs ceramic and porcelain manufacturer, inventors of iridescent metallic eosin glaze and architectural pyrogranite decorating Art Nouveau landmarks.
historicalSignificance: Early pioneer of digital craft & heritage brand showcases in Central Europe, publishing high-resolution galleries of master ceramic works, vases, and museum collections in the 90s.
currentStatusNote: Active official manufacturer & Zsolnay Cultural Quarter portal.
notableMilestone: Showcased Hungary's world-famous eosin porcelain craft to the global web

name: Sulinet - National School Internet Program
description: Transformative government program connecting all secondary and primary schools in Hungary with ISDN/leased lines.
historicalSignificance: Introduced an entire generation of Hungarian students (millions of young people) to the World Wide Web, email, and digital literacy in school computer labs.
currentStatusNote: Active educational resource repository and digital curriculum portal.
notableMilestone: Connected 1,500+ Hungarian schools to the internet before the year 2000

name: OTP Bank - First Online Banking in Hungary
description: Hungary's largest commercial bank, early adopter of web corporate presentations and online account queries.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered retail internet banking security and telebank web interfaces in Hungary.
currentStatusNote: Active primary portal for OTP Group.

name: Magyar Posta (Hungarian Post)
description: National postal service web portal with early postal code search and postage rate calculators.
historicalSignificance: One of Hungary's earliest high-volume public utility tools on the web.
currentStatusNote: Active modern postal & package tracking system.

name: Magyar Távirati Iroda (MTI)
description: National news agency wire service transmitting real-time breaking news to Hungarian publishers and early web editors.
historicalSignificance: Provided the real-time news feeds that powered the earliest Hungarian web portals like Internetto, Origo, and Startlap.
currentStatusNote: Active under Duna Médiaszolgáltató / MTI.

name: MOL - Hungarian Oil & Gas
description: Hungary's multinational energy company web domain.
historicalSignificance: Early corporate presence on the web with gas station locators and quarterly investor disclosures.
originalFounderOrOrg: MOL Magyar Olaj- és Gázipari Rt.
currentStatusNote: Active international energy portal.

name: Hungarian Meteorological Service (OMSZ / HungaroMet)
description: National weather service providing satellite imagery, radar maps, and forecasts.
historicalSignificance: One of the most bookmarked websites in 1990s Hungary for viewing daily weather maps and storm warnings.
currentStatusNote: Active meteorology portal (hungaromet.hu / met.hu).

name: Freemail.hu - The Legendary Hungarian Webmail
description: The monumental free webmail service created by C3 Foundation (Peternák Miklós, Erhardt Miklós, Szépvölgyi Miklós) that gave millions of Hungarians their first email address.
historicalSignificance: Became the undisputed #1 most trafficked website in Hungary during the late 90s and 2000s, later acquired by Matáv/Telekom.
currentStatusNote: Still fully active with millions of registered mailboxes operating today (now owned by Mediaworks).
notableMilestone: Gave over 3 million Hungarians their very first digital identity

name: HVG - Heti Világgazdaság Online
description: Leading weekly investigative and business journal that launched its online edition in 1997.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered serious political and economic reporting on the Hungarian web, alongside the legendary "Fülke" blogs.
currentStatusNote: One of Hungary's top independent online news portals.

name: Drótposta - Early Free Email Competitor
description: Early domestic free email service operated by Datanet, competing with Freemail.
historicalSignificance: Offered POP3 and webmail access with a distinctive Hungarian name (literal translation of "wire-mail").
currentStatusNote: Preserved under telecom archives / redirects.

name: Externet - Regional ISP Pioneer
description: Fast-growing ISP founded in Szolnok that provided independent high-speed dialup and early ADSL across rural Hungary.
historicalSignificance: Broke the capital-city monopoly of internet connectivity, expanding access to countryside towns.
currentStatusNote: Active business telecom brand.

name: Baranya Vármegyei Önkormányzat (Baranya County)
description: The official county government portal representing Baranya, the Mecsek mountain ranges, and historic municipalities surrounding Pécs.
historicalSignificance: Promoted regional tourism, cross-border Danube-Drava cultural initiatives, and South Transdanubian digital public administration in the late 1990s.
currentStatusNote: Active official county government portal.

name: Magyar Rádió (Hungarian Radio)
description: National public radio service, pioneer of early RealAudio live streaming broadcasts.
historicalSignificance: Introduced live RealAudio 28.8kbps streams for Kossuth, Petőfi, and Bartók Rádió in the late 90s.
currentStatusNote: Active under public media holding (mediaklikk.hu / radio.hu).

name: Origo.hu - Flagship Hungarian Web Portal
description: Launched by Matáv/Magyar Telekom with massive investment in December 1998 to be the definitive Hungarian internet portal.
historicalSignificance: Created iconic sub-sites like Szoftverbázis, Vizsla search engine, [origo] Filmklub, Játékbázis, and Chat.hu. Set the standard for modern Hungarian digital media.
originalFounderOrOrg: Matávnet / Magyar Telekom (Pohly Ferenc, Nádori Péter, Weyer Balázs)
currentStatusNote: Fully active major news portal (now Mediaworks).
notableMilestone: Built Vizsla, the first comprehensive Hungarian web crawler and search index

name: Magyar Narancs (Mancsat)
description: Iconic satirical and progressive cultural-political weekly known for its underground style and witty prose.
historicalSignificance: Hosted beloved early cultural forums, record reviews, and urban folklore commentaries in the late 90s.
currentStatusNote: Active weekly cultural portal.

name: SG.hu - IT, Science & Gaming Magazine
description: One of Hungary's earliest independent computer hardware, science fiction, and PC gaming daily magazines.
historicalSignificance: Cult following for 3D graphics card benchmarks (3dfx Voodoo, Riva TNT), tech hardware teardowns, and vibrant reader comments.
currentStatusNote: Continuously active tech magazine running since 1998.

name: MÁV - Hungarian State Railways
description: National railway company domain hosting train schedules and timetable search (Elvira).
historicalSignificance: Connected to Elvira.hu in the late 90s to create Hungary's most-consulted public transport timetable engine.
currentStatusNote: Active national railway portal.

name: Pécsi Egyházmegye (Diocese of Pécs / Roman Catholic Cathedral)
description: Millennium-old Roman Catholic diocese founded in 1009 by King Saint Stephen (Szent István), stewarding the iconic four-towered Pécs Cathedral (Szent Péter és Szent Pál Bazilika).
historicalSignificance: Among the earliest Hungarian ecclesiastical institutions on the web, publishing virtual architecture tours of the 11th-century Romanesque crypts, cathedral history, and diocese archives.
currentStatusNote: Active official diocese and cathedral portal.

name: Pécsi Kulturális Központ / Pécs Cultural Gateway
description: Cultural events and performing arts portal for Pécs, covering the National Theatre of Pécs (Pécsi Nemzeti Színház), Pécs Jazz Club, and the renowned Pécs Ballet.
historicalSignificance: Regional hub for arts schedules, theater programs, and South Transdanubian festivals in the late 90s.
currentStatusNote: Preserved under municipal and regional cultural registries.

name: Terminal.hu - Early Hungarian Tech Community
description: Influential early Hungarian IT enthusiast community, software downloads, and hardware forums.
historicalSignificance: Hosted vibrant forums on Linux installation, overclocking Pentium II CPUs, and modding games.
currentStatusNote: Active redirect / technology archive.

name: Index.hu - Giant of Hungarian Online News
description: Founded in April 1999 by the core editorial staff of Internetto (Nyírő András, Uj Péter, Gerényi Gábor, Kéki Balázs) after breaking away from IDG.
historicalSignificance: Defined Hungarian internet culture, Gonzo-style news reporting, created the legendary Index Fórumok (Hungary's largest discussion board), Totalcar, Velvet, and IndexVideó.
originalFounderOrOrg: Internetto team / Nyírő András, Uj Péter, Gerényi Gábor
currentStatusNote: Fully active as one of Hungary's highest-traffic daily news publications.
notableMilestone: Revolutionized Hungarian language journalism with sharp humor, breaking scoops, and reader forums

name: Startlap.hu - The Mother of Hungarian Link Directories
description: Created by Kékesi Zsuzsa and Varga Zoltán as an intuitive link catalog and custom browser homepage.
historicalSignificance: Expanded into thousands of thematic ".lap.hu" sub-pages (e.g. zene.lap.hu, budapest.lap.hu) curated by independent page editors. Served as the default browser startpage for over 50% of Hungarian PCs for over a decade.
currentStatusNote: Active modern curated portal and link directory.
notableMilestone: Built the iconic *.lap.hu ecosystem with thousands of community editors

name: Portfolio.hu - Leading Financial & Stock Portal
description: Hungary's leading stock exchange, macroeconomic, and investment news platform founded by financial analysts.
historicalSignificance: Provided real-time Budapest Stock Exchange (BÉT / BUX) quotes and currency charts during the dot-com boom.
originalFounderOrOrg: NET Média Zrt. (Csurgó Dénes, Bán Zoltán)
currentStatusNote: Active #1 financial media portal in Hungary.

name: Pécsi Napilap (Pécs Online Daily News)
description: One of Hungary's earliest independent provincial online newspapers dedicated to local breaking news, politics, and culture in Pécs and Baranya county.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered independent regional online journalism outside Budapest, providing South Transdanubian readers with direct local investigative reporting and cultural event guides in 1999.
currentStatusNote: Active local regional news portal.

name: Extra.hu - The Free Webhost of 90s Webmakers
description: Hungary's beloved free homepages host (akin to Geocities / Tripod) where thousands learned HTML and built fan sites.
historicalSignificance: Every teenager and hobbyist in 1999 Hungary built their first HTML site at extra.hu/~username with animated GIFs, MIDI music, and hit counters.
currentStatusNote: Maintained as historical brand under hosting group.

name: Magyar Origami Kör
description: One of the earliest hobby and craft associations in Hungary to register its own dedicated .hu domain.
historicalSignificance: Charming testament to the passionate non-profit clubs that embraced the early web in the mid-90s with step-by-step paper folding diagrams.
currentStatusNote: Still online at origami.hu with origami galleries and club events!

name: edu.hu - Hungarian Educational TLD Sub-zone
description: Delegated second-level domain for Hungarian educational and academic institutions.
historicalSignificance: Hosted hundreds of schools and educational projects under *.edu.hu during the 1990s.
currentStatusNote: Active DNS administrative zone.

name: Magyarország.hu - Central Governmental Portal
description: The official digital gateway of Hungary, created to aggregate all state services and citizen administrative information.
historicalSignificance: Became the central foundation for Ügyfélkapu (Citizen Gateway) and state digitization.
currentStatusNote: Fully active as the primary governmental single-window administration portal.

name: Kormány.hu - Government of Hungary
description: Official portal for the Cabinet, ministries, executive decrees, and government press releases.
historicalSignificance: Unified government communications under a single official .hu domain in the late 90s.
currentStatusNote: Active primary executive government portal.

name: Gedeon Richter - Hungarian Pharmaceutical Pioneer
description: Historic Hungarian pharmaceutical manufacturer with global presence.
historicalSignificance: One of the first Hungarian chemical/pharmaceutical firms with a bilingual digital product registry.
currentStatusNote: Active global pharma portal.

name: SzépIdő / Early Hungarian Weather Web
description: Pioneering amateur meteorological webcam and weather station community before Időkép was formed in the 2000s.
historicalSignificance: Crowdsourced weather readings and webcam snapshots of Hungarian skies.
currentStatusNote: Preserved in historical web directories and weather archives.

name: Nexus.hu - Free Webspace & Community
description: Hugely popular Hungarian free webspace provider in the late 90s, hosting thousands of personal fanpages, clan sites, and midi collections.
historicalSignificance: Together with Extra.hu and Tar.hu, formed the trinity of Hungarian 90s free homepages.
currentStatusNote: Domain redirected / preserved in telecom registry.
